items.t: Trump administration attempting to prosecute former FBI Director James Comey again

items.t: Australian judge rejects prisoner’s claim that access to Vegemite spread is a human right
items.x: A prisoner has lost his challenge to an Australian state’s ban on inmates eating Vegemite after he argued in court that withholding the polarizing yeast-based spread breached his human right to “enjoy his culture as an Australian.”

items.t: Fort Myers family-owned bakery receives royal request
items.x: A Fort Myers bakery got a royal order from King Mswati III of Eswatini, a surprising milestone for the family-run shop.

items.t: Suspected shooter still sought in Cape Coral road rage incident as license plate cameras sit dark
items.x: A driver was shot during a road rage incident in Cape Coral, prompting questions about the impact of deactivated license plate cameras on police investigations.

items.t: Leaking abandoned water line blamed for hole on Bay Beach Lane in Fort Myers Beach
items.x: A hole in the road on Bay Beach Lane near Estero Boulevard, caused by an abandoned water line, has prompted safety concerns for locals, though repairs are expected to be completed soon.

items.t: Trump says US is 'making a fortune' from higher oil prices. Who benefits?
items.x: President Donald Trump says higher oil prices are making America wealthier. But economists say the gains are concentrated among producers and investors, while consumers face rising costs.

items.t: Bodycam video shows moments after parents say cops were called on 3-year-old for being ‘too good’ at soccer
items.x: A viral video claimed police were called because a 3-year-old was too good at soccer. Winter Park police released body camera video and described a dispute over playing time and the parents’ conduct.

items.t: 'Crash ur row only': United flight turned around after passenger allegedly said he'd 'hijack' plane
items.x: A United Airlines flight was diverted back to Las Vegas shortly after takeoff over the weekend due to what police said was a report of a passenger making a terroristic threat.

items.t: Boy dies 5 years after being hit by crossfire in quadruple shooting
